## Overview

This 2026-09-15 **Marketplaces / Adyen for Platforms** export is the **onboarding-steps filter page**, intended to determine required user information and how to submit it to Adyen. The pinned Markdown contains filter choices and a partial current selection, but **no concrete onboarding-step result**. [[adyen-platforms]]

## Captured filter state

- Available filter dimensions are **onboarding type** (Hosted or API-only), **version**, **location**, and **legal-entity/legal-arrangement type**. The long location list and five entity-type labels are selectable filter values in this export, not a universal statement that every combination is supported. See [[raw/adyen/docs/marketplaces/onboard-users/onboarding-steps/2026-09-15|raw lines 23–28]].
- The capture’s current selection is **Hosted onboarding, version 4**. **Location** and **legal-entity/legal-arrangement type** are missing, so the page instructs selecting all required filters on the interactive page or adding missing query parameters to the `.md` URL for a concrete export. No country/entity-specific required fields or submission method can be extracted from this pinned page. See [[raw/adyen/docs/marketplaces/onboard-users/onboarding-steps/2026-09-15|raw lines 30–35]].

## Retrieval boundary

Use this page to locate the correct filtered onboarding steps; consult a fully specified, separately pinned result before asserting exact data requirements. This capture alone does not prove a user’s eligibility, verification approval or enabled capabilities.
